messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on continuous-batching execution path for /v1/stream/generate (hosted-prod). Started 2026-03-14T10:23:20Z. p95 850ms -> 1.2s, p99 4.8s -> 9.3s. Streaming stalls and partial response timeouts observed. Correlated with paging and long KV cache warms. Paging count up 3x in last 10m.

maya: paging oncall — I'm taking initial triage. Assigning priority: P1 until mitigated.

devon: oncall here, joining. Noted increased queuing on cont-batcher. Getting dashboards.

ellie: grabbing traces from jaeger and the streaming trace sampler. Any specific customer reports yet?

prod-support: support queue has 2 customer tickets: "generate hung" for partner-alpha and "incomplete stream" for billing-labs. Both started ~10:25Z.

maya: quick checklist: (1) confirm scope (routes/models) (2) try config-based mitigation (batch caps / fairshare) (3) customer comms if needed (4) handoff plan if long-running.

devon: scope: mostly /v1/stream/generate (streaming), model variant gpt-open-8q-contbatch (continuous batching runtime). Non-streamed endpoints not affected except small p95 bump. Logs show many long sequences (>10k tokens) causing very large batches and scheduler starvation for streaming connections.

ellie: traces show two common patterns: long KV cache fill + blocking kernel selection path. Streaming requests get queued behind a batch that ends up with 40+ seqs.

maya: proposed mitigation 1 (low-risk, config): set max_cont_batch_size=8 and enable batch_shedding=true for cont-batcher pool. Also enforce fairshare weights: streaming_weight=2, batch_weight=1 so streaming gets priority.

devon: agreed. I'll push config via /ops/config and trigger reload on cont-batcher group. Command: 
```
redwoodctl config set pool.cont-batcher.max_cont_batch_size=8 
redwoodctl config set pool.cont-batcher.batch_shedding=true 
redwoodctl config set pool.cont-batcher.scheduling_weights.streaming=2 
redwoodctl service reload cont-batcher --grace 30s
```

maya: also enable the temporary routing fallback: route 10% of streaming traffic to low-latency quantized-variant (gpt-open-8q-q8) to reduce pressure while we stabilize.

kai: I can patch the router rule. Will put 10% override for streaming route. Command: 
```
redwoodctl route update /v1/stream/generate --traffic-split "contbatch:90,quant:10" --scope hosted-prod
```

maya: small note: enabling batch_shedding will drop some very large batched requests — probably retry-safe but flag to PS for customer impact.

prod-support: noted. I'll prepare a short status to send to the two affected customers: ETA ~10m for initial mitigation.

devon: rolling config now. Applying max_cont_batch_size and shedding...

incident-bot: ACTION: config change applied by devon at 2026-03-14T10:28:10Z. Service reload triggered for cont-batcher.

ellie: monitoring histograms: p99 started to trend down within 90s of reload. p99 now ~3.1s at 10:30Z, p95 ~900ms. Paging events still elevated but falling.

kai: router patch applied (10% to quant). Verified traffic split and successful handshakes for quantized model for sample streams.

maya: good. Next step: drain any currently executing huge batches. devon, can you run the batch drain script on the affected hosts?

devon: running: 
```
for host in $(redwoodctl pool list-hosts cont-batcher); do redwoodctl host exec $host -- /usr/local/bin/drain-long-batches --age-threshold 5m & done
```

incident-bot: NOTE: drain script executed on 6 hosts, started 10:31:05Z.

ellie: after drain and shedding, p99 stable ~1.1s at 10:36Z. Streaming stalls counts dropped from 420/min -> 15/min. Traces show fewer queued batches > 12 seqs.

prod-support: updated customers: "Mitigation in progress - temporary config applied to reduce latency and we are routing some traffic to a low-latency variant. Monitoring impact. Will follow up when fully resolved."

maya: customer impact assessment: short-lived partial failures for long-running generations (likely > 5k tokens) — estimated 120 jobs dropped retriable across 2 customers. No data exposure. Recommend CS follow-up with retry guidance.

sre-lead: good call on shedding. We should also open a follow-on ticket to improve mixed-seqlen scheduling: consider weighted batching by seqlen buckets, or dynamic batch caps based on current seqlen distribution.

devon: creating follow-up RFC ticket: "adaptive-batching: seqlen-aware batching + scheduler fairness" with immediate engineering tasks (A) seqlen histogram export to metrics (B) dynamic cap controller (C) per-tenant batch limits.

maya: oncall handoff planned in 2h. If we stay stable, I'll hand to kai. Kai — you get the pager at 12:30Z, checklist below:
- verify p99/p95 remained stable for 30m
- verify no backlog on cont-batcher hosts
- keep shedding enabled until we ship safer controls
- coordinate with infra to schedule a canary test for weighted batching tomorrow

kai: acknowledged. I'll take the handoff at 12:30Z UTC. My mobile is on.

ellie: quick postmortem notes while fresh: root cause summary: mixed sequence lengths produced very large batches on continuous-batching path; scheduler fairness wasn't prioritizing streaming; paging amplified kernel latencies due to KV cache warms. Immediate remediation: batch cap + shedding + routing fallback. Medium-term: seqlen-aware batching and scheduling.

maya: thanks everyone. Closing the P1 once we confirm 45m of stable metrics. Leaving this thread open for handoff notes. :white_check_mark:

kai: I will post confirmation or escalate if anything regresses.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 back to 1.0s baseline, streaming stall rate <5/min. Monitoring continues. Logged incident ID: IN-2026-0314-01.

maya: handing over to kai now. handing-off: state=mitigated config=active followups=[INC-2026-0314-01, RFC-adaptive-batching].

kai: taking over. Thanks all.

prod-support: final note: customers contacted and ticket statuses set to "mitigated - followup scheduled".

ellie: saved relevant traces and dashboards into /dashboards/cont-batch/2026-03-14-10-incident for postmortem.

sre-lead: great coordination. Postmortem due EOD. Add quantitative impact: p99 delta, dropped jobs, affected customers.

maya: closing thread from my side — will add postmortem link when ready.

kai: (12:45Z) quick sanity: p99 1.04s, p95 0.12s, streaming stalls 2/min. Holding.

incident-bot: THREAD LOGGED: 1815000000.
